records.quote: gpecto, Svi, atom, 1 ,vfieq a [id], to  look at, behold, to gaze at, natch, obsene ,
records.entryNote: OCR mangles the headword ("gpecto, Svi, atom, 1 ,vfieq a"); the gloss "to look at, behold" is intact. specto is the frequentative of specio.

records.quote: spcctio, oms,/ [specio], in the lang  or augurs, an observing of the auspices ,  hence, al c o, the right of observing them
records.entryNote: Derivative of specio: "[specio], in the language of augurs, an observing of the auspices". This is the only place where the base verb specio itself is named in L&S.

note: L&S 的 specto（specio 的反复形）释义为 "to look at, behold"，派生词 spectio 明确标注 [specio]，与词库 specere「看」一致。
